title: Implementation Plan task
description: One agent-buildable task: one pass of work. Mirrors Task in harness/src/types.ts.

repo.description: A repo under `repos` in the project config; validation checks it is one.

stage.description: The milestone it belongs to, one the TaskSet declares under `stages`. Optional: a plan without stages has no stage gating.

epic.description: The epic's key in its lane (plan/taskset.yaml); the lane is the task's repo.

feature.description: The product area the plan documents group the task under: a planner's name in plan/planners.yaml.

agent.description: Pins the task to one agent.

role.description: Which of the agent's configured models runs the task, build when absent. Design is creative work (art, animation) that may finish after later stages open, so nothing may wait on it.

summary.description: What the last pass that changed the task's state did, for the dependency map. Written by the loop.

kept.description: The branch this attempt's work is kept on, for the next attempt to finish: it passed its own gate, but main changed under it.
